text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, we went out at Special Week's suggestion.
She was pumped to take Silence Suzuka
to her 'special spot', but—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Um. Spe-chan,
is this our destination?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: (Wh... where the heck am I!?!?!?)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: (What do I do!? I was supposed to go to the newly opened amusement park, so why am I at a ranch!? I'm totally lost, by gosh~!)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Spe-chan, umm...
Well... it's a lovely place.
The scenery is beautiful, and the air is so fresh...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
The only reason I could come to such a wonderful place is because Spe-chan invited me today.
...So, um, please don't worry too much—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
(...Wait, really!? Suzuka-san,
you haven't realized you're lost...!? In fact,
are you actually enjoying wandering around here...!?)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"—W-Well, isn't that truly wonderful!
N-Now then, let me give you an energetic tour!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: "...Huh? But Spe-chan, you got l—"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Let's head out! This, uh, um...
'Fluffy Ranch' has so much to see~!
...Probably!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Wasn't it called
'Honwaka Ranch', if I recall?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ehh!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was completely obvious she was lost, but Special Week enthusiastically took the lead as our guide anyway—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
—How was it, Suzuka-san!
The petting zoo corner with the goats!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes. He was so friendly that I was taken aback at first, but...
He was so, so cute.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Plus, Spe-chan is giving me such a cheerful tour.
It feels like... her energy is rubbing off on me, so to speak."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
(...Thank goodness! It's a place I've never been, but
I'm used to ranches anyway...!
Looks like Suzuka-san's enjoying herself too!)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
You're quite the wonderful guide, Spe-chan.
...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so? Ahaha,
hahaha, oh you flatter me~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...I know! How about I show you something interesting right now?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Special Week bought several bottles of milk.
She then proceeded to drink them down one by one
right in front of the grazing dairy cows.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! I've got it!
The one who gave the first bottle of milk was...
that Guernsey right there!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"The second bottle is from the Jersey cow up front!
And the third bottle is from that big Holstein cow in the back!"

text_block_list.name: Dairy Cows
text_block_list.text: ...Mooo.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh? I knew you could do milk blind taste tests... but you can even tell that much?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Milk makes up most of my body, after all!
I've been drinking it like water
ever since I was little!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Incredible... Not only do you understand milk, you understand the cows themselves. Spe-chan, you must be Japan's number one milk sommelier master.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
E-Ehehe~...! 
Aww, you're flattering me~...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I want to keep looking around more and more, but it's about time we head back.
Spe-chan, the way back is—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
choice_data_list: Shall we enjoy ourselves just a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "...You're right! There was a butter-making corner over there too! Let's stay and have a bit more fun!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Y-Yes, you're right.
Shall we go check it out?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, th-that's right!
We should stop by the souvenir corner later too!
Ha, ha...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, after having our fun for a while,
we eventually had to confess, managed to find
our way back, and returned to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Waaaah!!
I'm so sorry, Suzuka-san!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Actually, right now... we are totally and utterly lost!
We were supposed to go to the amusement park...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it, Spe-chan.
I knew from the beginning. Besides...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"It might not have gone as planned,
but I still had plenty of fun.
...Thanks to our guide, that is."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: S-S-Suzuka-saaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And after asking the ranch staff for directions back,
we were able to safely return to the academy."
